examples: I feel sad.
It was a sad story.
She is sad.

more.def: Feeling unhappy or causing unhappy feelings.
examples: He felt sad when his friend moved away.
It was a sad movie about a lost puppy.
She was sad because the party was over.
The kitten is safe in the box.
Wear a helmet to stay safe.
It is safe to cross now.

more.def: Free from danger or harm, or not likely to cause harm.
examples: A helmet keeps your head safe when you ride a bike.
It is safe to swim here because the water is calm.
The lost hikers were safe once the rescuers found them.

easy.def: A strong box with a lock.
examples: The jewels were locked in a safe.
Dad keeps papers in a safe.
The safe has a secret number.

more.def: A strong metal box with a lock, used to keep valuable things.
examples: The bank keeps gold coins in a big metal safe.
Only my grandmother knows the code that opens the safe.
The treasure was locked in an old safe in the attic.
We hurried for the sake of the baby.
Be careful for your own sake.
He stayed for his friend's sake.

more.def: The good or benefit of someone or something.
examples: For the sake of the sleeping baby, we whispered.
She walked slowly for her grandmother's sake.
Do it for your own sake.
We have the same hat.
They are the same size.
I ate the same lunch.

more.def: Exactly alike, or not different in any way.
examples: The twins wore the same coat to school.
Two plus two is the same as one plus three.
We go to the same park every Saturday.
The dog saved the boy.
Save the bird.
He saved a cat.

more.def: To keep a person or thing safe from harm or loss.
examples: The lifeguard saved the swimmer who was tired.
Firefighters saved the kitten from the tall tree.
Planting trees can help save the forest.

easy.def: To keep something to use later.
examples: I save my money.
Save me a seat.
She saves old boxes.

more.def: To keep money or things so that you can use them later.
examples: I am saving my coins to buy a new bike.
Save some cake for your sister.
We saved the leftover soup for lunch tomorrow.
Say hello to Grandpa.
She said her name.
The sign says stop.

more.def: To speak words aloud, or to show something in writing.
examples: Please say your name and your favorite food to the class.
The recipe says to bake the cookies for ten minutes.
He said that he would be late for dinner.
